title: Boston canonical geospatial — Stage 1A SCHEMA CANDIDATE
description: NOT the production canonical schema. A candidate proposed by Stage 1A for Owner review. File-level invariants live in `source`; per-feature records carry only what varies. FACT = supplied by the source. DERIVED = computed deterministically from FACT. INFERRED = not supplied by any source; Stage 1A emits NONE, by design.

adapterVersion.description: path@semver of the normalizer that produced this file

source.description: Invariant for every feature in the file. Hoisted rather than repeated per feature.

sourceCrs.description: EPSG code of the SOURCE, before any transform

transform.description: the exact transform chain, ending in the production geo()

coordinates.description: The world frame. `projection` MUST name src/core/Geo.js and MUST record that it is unchanged.

rejected.description: Every source feature not emitted, with a machine-readable reason. Never silently dropped.

sourceTimestamp.description: per-feature edit date if the source supplies one; null otherwise. NEVER the retrieval date.

fact.description: Supplied by the source, in the SOURCE's own units. Nothing here is converted, so a successor can re-derive independently.

derived.description: Computed from FACT by the adapter. Reproducible from FACT plus adapterVersion.

rings.description: Outer ring first, holes after. [x, z] in Boston local metres, 2 dp. Closing vertex NOT repeated. Outer CCW, holes CW, normalized by signed area so source winding is irrelevant.

heightBasis.description: the exact arithmetic, e.g. 'BLDG_HGT_2010 x 0.3048'. Null when no height was supplied.

confidence.description: FACT_IF_PRESENT = source supplied a height. FACT_GEOMETRY_ONLY = footprint only, no height; downstream must NOT invent one. INFERRED is reserved and unused in Stage 1A.

notes: featureClass BUILDING_PART is deliberate: the Roof Breaks layer partitions roofs, not buildings. 95.0% of parts in the Stage 1A fixture share an edge with a sibling. A production schema needs a separate BUILDING level, produced by a dissolve step that Stage 1A did not attempt.
No facade, window, cornice, material or architectural attribute appears anywhere in this schema. The source supplies none, and inventing them is what INFERRED exists to forbid.
Elevations are kept in source feet and NOT converted to the game's vertical frame. The source's vertical datum is unresolved; converting would manufacture a false absolute.
